protected_routes.resource_mapping: document:{document_id}, resolved by map_operation from the path parameter against the document catalog; the one member of OperationContext.resources; query parameters and headers that can change what is returned are part of the bound operation; the response is one JSON document

enforcement_points.component: Gateway authentication stage, before routing; produces the principal in the namespace of the authenticating mechanism, with the authenticated device identifier and the connection's peer address as Principal attributes

Enrollment registry lookup inside the gateway, by the realm, the authenticated workload, and the agent ID that the presentation names; whether a workload may carry more than one record is the choice of the authenticating profile
Gateway mapping stage, mapping revision pact-abac-1; builds the OperationContext for the document read
Fact adapters for principal, department, clearance, device compliance, classification, owning department, network zone, and time over approved native paths

Installed gateway checks run on the authenticated principal and the agent binding: the ABAC policy-version check, which reads device_id and peer_address from the principal, native-delegation-v1, and execution-identity-v1; native-principal-binding-v1 is the validator's
Adapter decision client calling the OPA REST Data API; a native denial is final; the executor rereads device, zone, and time and applies the obligations before disclosure
Gateway outcome writer, and the executor's immutable native record of the decision, the obligations applied, and the executor identity

Identity adapter and the fact adapters behind read_native_claim exist; the decision client of this profile is the reference implementation go/adapters/abac
Enrollment registry, administrator-run enrollment; to be supplied by the deployment
Delegation registry holding user, agent, and task authority, behind native-delegation-v1; exists

HR/identity adapter, security-attribute service, device-management adapter, document catalog, the gateway itself for network zone and time, enrollment registry, and hold store; exist as the sources of freshness, membership_sources, and attribute_sources
Not used: the sample policy needs no external approval; a policy that does adds this component and an approval-class check
Mapper at revision pact-abac-1 for the operation and the policy input; to be supplied
OPA with the installed policy as the native decision exists; the document service as obligation executor is assumed and specified by the profile rules
Replay and receipt store, and the shared store of the monotonic guard; to be supplied
Gateway outcome writer and the executor's native record; to be supplied
Not used: PACT Reputation 0.1 is not claimed

Registry of base requirements and the installed-check registry holding the pinned policy version; registry only, no adaptation lifecycle; the OPA policy source is a native store owned by the policy owner
Revocation and hold store; to be supplied
Access-controlled evidence and audit store, including the OPA decision log; to be supplied
Not used: the document read has no transaction or budget
Not used: no runtime or data-use guarantee is claimed; obligation enforcement is resource enforcement by C08 before disclosure, and use after disclosure is attested-only

bypass_paths.path: Direct request to the document service from any host other than the gateway
bypass_paths.evidence: Network policy admits only the gateway as a source, and the executor refuses a request that lacks the decision envelope; negative case ABAC-21

bypass_paths.path: Direct request to the policy decision point's Data, Policy, or other API by any process other than the adapter, including a write of policy or data
bypass_paths.evidence: The PDP authenticates its clients and authorizes the adapter identity only for POST on the decision path; negative case ABAC-22

bypass_paths.path: Other actions on the same documents: export, download, search, list
bypass_paths.evidence: Only the document read route is listed in protected_routes; excluded in unsupported_forms

bypass_paths.path: Other applications or routes that read the document store or the catalog directly
bypass_paths.evidence: The claim covers the document read route only; excluded in unsupported_forms

bypass_paths.path: A shared HTTP response cache between the executor and the agent
bypass_paths.evidence: A cached copy of a disclosed response would be served without a new decision; excluded in unsupported_forms, and the deployment disables caching for the route

unsupported_forms: Universal policies, or a PACT policy language: only the native OPA policy and its decision document are claimed; PACT defines no policy language, no other engine, and no policy, and the clearance chain and sample rule are illustrative

Instantaneous propagation of a fact change: a change reaches a decision within the status bound of its source and, for device, zone, and time, again at execution within 30 seconds; nothing faster is promised
Policy input taken from the agent, including a signed evidence artifact: evidence the agent carries is compared and discarded, and the input carries the authoritative value
Clearance with compartments or any order that is not one chain: only a configured finite chain of levels is claimed
Obligation types other than filter_fields, redact, and watermark, deny-list filtering, and parameters beyond those the profile defines: any other is unmet and nothing is disclosed

Obligations on content that is not a JSON document, other than a watermark whose means the mapping declares, and disclosure that streams bytes before every obligation is applied: the executor must hold the content until every obligation is applied and verified

Policy rules specific to an agent, a task, or a purpose: the input has no agent identifier, task, or purpose, and the task relation is established by native-delegation-v1 and the purpose and operation check
Any action other than document.read on the listed route, including export: not listed, so not claimed
Execution-time recheck of principal, department, clearance, classification, or owning department: only device, zone, and time are read again, and the others rely on their admission-time bounds
Reuse of a decision across requests, and an embedded or non-REST OPA interface: every decision is a new query through the REST Data API
Verification of policy content from policy_version or from a bundle revision: both are labels the policy publisher sets, and the profile pins and compares them
Observation mode: obligations are not enforced there
Enforcement of data use after disclosure: execution-control-v1 is not in the contract, and use after disclosure is attested-only

freshness.source: Network zone and time (the gateway itself, environment.network_zone and environment.time)
Enrollment registry (agent and key binding status)

attribute_sources.freshness: Network zone and time (the gateway itself, environment.network_zone and environment.time)

residual_limits: Post-read: content disclosed after the obligations were applied is outside the executor's control, since the agent can copy, forward, or export it; a watermark marks a copy and does not prevent copying; purpose and data-use restrictions are attested-only because execution-control-v1 is not in the contract; an executed read is not undone by revoking its receipt; disclosed here with no bound

Revocation propagation: a change at the principal, clearance, classification, owning department, enrollment, or hold source is seen at the next read with status bound 0, within each source's own consistency; a department change within 60 s; a device, zone, or time change within 30 s at admission and again at execution

Decision-to-release window: the principal, department, clearance, classification, and owning department are not read again at execution, so a change between the decision and the release is not seen; the window is bounded by the executor's own request deadline, not by PACT
Policy label: policy_version and the bundle revision are labels, and a policy change that keeps the label is invisible to the pin; change control belongs to the policy owner

Source integrity: the fact sources are authoritative by assumption, and a corrupted record yields a decision that looks correct; PACT detects stale facts and disagreement with the agent's claim, not a wrong source

Decision log content: the OPA log event carries the full input and result, so clearance, department, and device state are stored with it as protected evidence; a mask rule reduces what a replay can reproduce, and log delivery requeues, backs off, and drops events above a rate limit

Obligation granularity: filter_fields and redact act on JSON Pointers of one JSON document; response size, timing, error text, and the vacuous satisfaction of a pointer that resolves to nothing are side channels the profile does not close
Time rules: a policy rule conditioned on environment.time can be 30 s out of date at execution
